content:
🔍 Project Tracker Auditor: Cross-references meeting notes with project trackers to flag outdated information and missing items.

📰 Newsletter Aggregator: Scans @Gmail for newsletters, extracts and researches high-value links, and compiles them into a structured daily summary.

📈 Brand Health Auditor: Get a weekly summary of key themes from user feedback on your business' @GoogleMaps reviews and @YouTube videos.

💼 Sales Negotiation Coach: Uses enterprise software sales strategies to draft emails countering discount requests, identify buyer constraints, and preserve contract value.

🗂️ Drive Organizer: Audits @GoogleDrive for misplaced files and reorganizes them in batches with your approval.

📅 Client Meeting Prep: Searches calendar, emails, and documents for context to draft a tactical meeting agenda, appends it to your "Client Meeting Agendas" @GoogleDocs.
author: GeminiApp
